# CBT Associates

> > Evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy and psychological services for adults, children, and adolescents across the Greater Toronto Area.

CBT Associates is a leading mental health provider in Toronto, Aurora, and North York offering individual, couples, group, and family therapy since 2002. The clinic specializes in CBT and related evidence-based approaches including mindfulness, acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), and motivational interviewing, with both in-person and virtual therapy options.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Mental health treatment
- Evidence-based therapy
- Virtual/video therapy
- Adult therapy
- Child and adolescent therapy
- Anxiety and depression treatment
- Psychological assessment
- Toronto therapy services
- Greater Toronto Area
- Clinical psychology
- Couples and family therapy
- ADHD and autism treatment
- School support and IEPs
- Disability management

- [CBT Associates Homepage](https://www.cbtassociates.com): CBT Associates homepage: evidence-based therapy for emotions, thoughts, behaviors

- [Child and Adolescent CBT Services](https://www.cbtassociates.com/children-adolescents): CBT services for children and adolescents with school support and IEPs
- [Child and Adolescent Therapy](https://www.cbtassociates.com/children-adolescents/children-adolescents-treatment): Child and adolescent therapy for mood, anxiety, school avoidance disorders
- [Virtual and Video Therapy](https://www.cbtassociates.com/virtual-therapy-digital-therapy): Virtual and video therapy options for flexible, remote mental health care
